parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the topmost part of the dispenser, made of durable plastic, typically small and ergonomically shaped for finger pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to press down and activate the pump mechanism, dispensing liquid from the container.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed, returning to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head connects the pressing lid to the internal pump system, made of plastic and designed to channel liquid upward.
parts.Functional_description: It transfers the liquid from the internal tube to the outlet when the lid is pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly with the pressing lid but mainly serves as a conduit for liquid flow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main cylindrical container of the dispenser, made of plastic and designed to hold liquid soap or lotion.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid and provides structural support for the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the stable base of the dispenser.
